title: Hatshepsut's reign and building programme
summary: Hatshepsut ruled Egypt as pharaoh during a period of prosperity and peace, sent a trade mission to Punt and built the temple at Deir el-Bahari.
why: One of ancient Egypt's most prolific builders.

unsung.contribution: Ruled as pharaoh, funded the Punt expedition and built temples including Deir el-Bahari.
unsung.recognition: Later her statues were destroyed, monuments defaced and many of her achievements ascribed to other pharaohs.
